# ci/cd: extend dependabot config by labels and remove oldname

Make Dependabot's pull requests carry the repository's own labels and stop vendoring names. **Motivation:** "use predefined labels instead of vendoring" — the label scheme lives in [.github/settings.yml](../../.github/settings.yml) ([[DOT-387]]), so the [`labels` option](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/dependabot/dependabot-version-updates/configuration-options-for-the-dependabot.yml-file#labels) should reference it rather than Dependabot's default `dependencies` label.
